correctness.rationale: The exact 49-case support transition proof is independent of graph size; each color transition is a deterministic map within each part whose activation depends only on whether the other part contains state 1. Closed macro support classes are (0,0), (012,012), and the two-cycle (01,02) <-> (02,01); at micro level these have exact periods 1, 3, 4. Noncyclic supports cannot contain periodic microstates, so macro entry depths are exact. Inclusion-exclusion weights for each prescribed support yield all ten all-size counts, sum 3^(a+b), and integral cycle numbers. Standalone verifier recomputed the 49 transitions; 72,720 exhaustive microstates and 3,000 larger randomly seeded microstates agreed. Finite samples are supplementary, not substituted for the 49-support all-size proof.

value.rationale: The parameter-free four-step horizon and complete two-parameter labelled microstate basin census resolve a natural and previously unreported quantitative relaxation question for canonical excitable dynamics on the densest nontrivial bipartite graph family. Exact distinctions between period-three basins (no transients) and period-four basins (three possible depths), onset thresholds by community size, and rational Artin–Mazur zeta constitute meaningful structural classification. The fact is not a routine restatement of general qualitative asymptotic activity results.
